opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, Ruud speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Agent: find. Give me the new address.
verification.comment: You changed the order without first confirming the caller's full name plus order number or postcode on the account; verify identity before changing any order data.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi Ruud, I need to change the delivery address on my order. I've joost moved and I'm really stressed about this, it's urgent.
understanding.comment: You captured the address change request, but you did not acknowledge the caller's stress or check the dispatch concern in a way that addressed the actual issue.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will to the new address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the order could not be changed after dispatch; promising delivery to the new address was incorrect and the 3 to 4 working day timeline is also unsupported by the policy's standard 2 to 4 days for delivery to the original address.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
process_compliance.comment: The address change was made on a dispatched order, which policy does not allow, and the call did not follow the verification step before changing order data.

communication.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling titwell. Bye.
communication.comment: The caller said they were stressed and urgent, and you did not acknowledge that; your dismissive reply and misspelled company name also fell short of a polite tone.

closing.quote: Agent: It'll be there in 3 to 4 working days. Anything else?
closing.comment: You asked if there was anything else, but the next-step confirmation was inaccurate and the closing was abrupt.
